recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; the current specification satisfies the seed request, and additional prose would duplicate existing guidance rather than change implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-14195 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked the specification to account for version declarations on canonical URIs in search, documenting :below use for canonical searches and enabling :below for the Reference search type.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 9fedb176f1b13c7f956feb90cb4ecfe17e84ef36, SVN revision 14047, which added source/search.html canonical :below examples matching all versions for an unversioned canonical and only major-version 1 resources for a |1 search.
additional_context: FHIR-16361 moved canonical/version search wording into reference-search guidance, while later FHIR-46311 and FHIR-51466 clarified exact default matching and canonical :above/:below comparison behavior. FHIR-46311 and FHIR-51466 already have combined-branch reconciliation commits and do not supersede the seed rule.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/search.html already states that canonical references use reference search parameters with version syntax, has a dedicated :below/canonical section, and includes questionnaire:below examples for all versions and major version 1. source/references.html also says servers should support version-specific canonical URL searching by detecting |[version].
